title: Telegram Listener Service State
description: Listens for incoming Telegram messages via a bot and pushes each text message into the pipeline. (Runtimes: node; IDs: telegram-listener)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

allowedChatId.description: If set, only messages from this chat ID are forwarded

connect.description: Send { connect: true } to start polling

disconnect.description: Send { disconnect: true } to stop polling

running.description: Whether the polling loop is active
